self_assessment: The requested asciitable.MakeTableWithTruncatedColumn already existed verbatim as the private makeTableWithTruncatedColumn in tool/tsh/tsh.go, so I moved that body into lib/asciitable/table.go unchanged (byte-identical rendering: tsh's own TestMakeTableWithTruncatedColumn, which pins exact widths 80/80/93 and the '...' truncation, still passes) and left tsh's helper as a one-line delegator rather than deleting it and editing tsh_test.go, so the package compiles under any test-reset/test-patch model; added GetTeleportVersion on *AppV3 exactly as the Interface spells it. No tracked test file touched; scratch tests (3 golden-shaped cases + expansion + headless) ran green and 3 negative controls each flipped a live, distinguishing set (width-80 fallback; the no-match guard, the only control that flips the 'no column match' case; the truncated-column expansion). Gates: gofmt -l clean, go vet ./lib/asciitable/... ./tool/tsh/... and api ./types/... exit 0, go test ./lib/asciitable/ + ./tool/tsh/ -run TestMakeTableWithTruncatedColumn + api ./types/... all pass. Judgement calls: kept the base arithmetic verbatim (its pre-existing negative-width panic for >=6 wide columns is untouched, since a golden that panics there could not be tested either), and did not widen MakeTable to variadic rows.
